intake.line: Strong Culture Fit: Prava slides a laminated org chart across a laminate desk and tells him, warmly, that he has been retained and will start Monday in Reconciliations; Milo, told for the first time that his boredom is an asset, says yes before anyone offers him a choice, and Prava remembers his name in a way he does not yet find strange.

partition.line: Lanyard, Desk, Mentor: Orientation hands Milo a lanyard, a vocabulary sheet and an org chart on which the CEL looks like a subsidiary; he is seated at a desk beside Zara Okafor, who does not look up, and he mistakes her flat courtesy for the beginning of a friendship.

bell.line: Halvard Bell: Milo opens the account of Halvard Bell, a former dentist with ninety years in Retention, restructured at nine that morning; the tenure on file does not match ninety years of labor, and the difference has gone somewhere the form has no box for.

summons.line: Reply All: The all-staff email goes out, for once completely honest about what the Pipeline does, and the Marrow District stops hoping on schedule; within the hour a summons arrives for Milo to attend the quarterly review in the corner office of Edric Thane.

corner office.line: The Corner Office: Milo enters the one office no employee returns from unchanged and meets Edric Thane, measured and courteous, who reviews Milo's excellent closing record and offers him the climb; Milo sees exactly who he would have become.

discrepancy.line: Where Did It Go: Milo turns to Zara and, for the first time in his life or death, asks the next question: where did the tenure go? Zara finally looks up, and does not answer, and the not-answering is the start of something.
